name: oncall-copilot
description: On-Call Copilot: unified desktop engineering memory agent

scripts.backend: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "& { if (Test-Path backend\.venv\Scripts\python.exe) { backend\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m uvicorn app.main:app --port 8000 } else { python -m uvicorn app.main:app --port 8000 } }"
scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix desktop run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix frontend run typecheck && npm --prefix desktop run typecheck
